title: Jair Judges Israel (22 years)
summary: Jair the Gileadite judges Israel twenty-two years; his thirty sons ride thirty ass colts and hold thirty cities, Havoth-jair (Judg 10:3–5).
description: Judges-period record added from James B. Jordan's chronology (secondary display) with Ussher, Jones and, where available, CFAH-1 Table 1 dates for sorting. Jordan treats the judgeships as partly overlapping regional sequences (North / Centre / South) fitted to the 480 years of 1 Kgs 6:1 and the 300 years of Judg 11:26.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (F. N. Jones): 1192 BC (no higher-tier year available). Jordan (secondary display) never sets the sort.

chronologies.note: 2001 revision. Jordan's 1991 list (BC 3:8) has an earlier year; see the second Jordan entry. The 2001 list gives no separate year for Jair's death; 2861 is the start of the joint Philistine/Ammonite oppression. End year not inferred.
